description: The manageiq_alert_profiles module supports adding, updating and deleting alert profiles in ManageIQ.

parameters.name: alerts
parameters.description: List of alert descriptions to assign to this profile. Required if state=present.

parameters.name: ca_cert
parameters.description: The path to a CA bundle file or directory with certificates.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: ManageIQ password. MIQ_PASSWORD environment variable if set. Otherwise, required if no token is passed in.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: ManageIQ token. MIQ_TOKEN environment variable if set. Otherwise, required if no username or password is passed in.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: ManageIQ environment URL. MIQ_URL environment variable if set. Otherwise, it is required to pass it.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: ManageIQ username. MIQ_USERNAME environment variable if set. Otherwise, required if no token is passed in.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether SSL certificates should be verified for HTTPS requests. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The unique alert profile name in ManageIQ.

parameters.name: resource_type
parameters.description: The resource type for the alert profile in ManageIQ. Required when state=present. Choices: "Vm" "ContainerNode" "MiqServer" "Host" "Storage" "EmsCluster" "ExtManagementSystem" "MiddlewareServer"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: absent - alert profile should not exist, present - alert profile should exist. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

examples:
- name: Add an alert profile to ManageIQ
  community.general.manageiq_alert_profiles:
    state: present
    name: Test profile
    resource_type: ContainerNode
    alerts:
      - Test Alert 01
      - Test Alert 02
    manageiq_connection:
      url: 'http://127.0.0.1:3000'
      username: 'admin'
      password: 'smartvm'
      validate_certs: false # only do this when you trust the network!

- name: Delete an alert profile from ManageIQ
  community.general.manageiq_alert_profiles:
    state: absent
    name: Test profile
    manageiq_connection:
      url: 'http://127.0.0.1:3000'
      username: 'admin'
      password: 'smartvm'
      validate_certs: false # only do this when you trust the network!
